title: SuperAnthony's Joltzsi
description:
Joltzsi (Jolt-see) is an addictive action puzzle game building off classic predecessors such as Columns, Puyo Puyo and Tetris.
Its "stacking" feature adds a unique strategic twist to the block-falling genre.

• Layer "falling" tetrominoes on top of each other increasing values from 1 to 4.

• Clears lines with vertical and horizontal matches.

• Score Big with higher values and multiple lines BUT pieces can fall fast, and going above 4 is "Game Over".

 
Try to make the highest possible clear, a 4 line 4 height Joltzsi 4 MAX POINTS 
Enjoy multiple game modes and options
• Advanced Mode with multi-valued pieces

• Glitched Mode with a series of unique rules throughout perpetual play

• Competitive Online PVP Battles Mode, Seasons and Tournaments

• Special On-Fire Edition DLC featuring the Voice of NBA Jam Tim Kitzrow! 

• And several more modes!

Be the leader by:
• Having the highest score (All Time, Monthly, Weekly]

• Competing in regular seasons and tournaments 

• Winning in PVP and Battle Mode

• Being among the first to accomplish something with several stats being tracked for all-time 

Joltzsi was designed to be an deep yet easy to pick up and play game perfect when you're on the go!
description_short: Can't get enough falling blocks in your diet? Then curb your appetite with a whole new layer on the genre, literally! It's the arcade action of Tetris meets 1010 and 2048. Now, clear 4x4 Joltzsis for that Boomshakalaka!
